name: Ann C Mcguire

events.title: Marriage
events.description: Married Herman Gunster (1904-1979); lived at Lee Park, Hanover Twp, 1935-40

bioAdditions: Youngest daughter of James McGuire and Anna C. Jones (Anna Maguire in the 1910 Larksville census). She married Herman Gunster in 1935, lived at Lee Park, and died 7 Nov 1964 (S1).
